components.note: Sense graph joins live senses by resolved relation edges. The lexeme graphs merge all senses of a lexeme (the partition unit that keeps a headword's renditions on one side); the taxonomic variant uses only synonym/antonym/hypernym/hyponym/instance_of edges.
